# Board CAD source review

Reviewed: 2026-11-02. This file distinguishes source CAD from validated web models. A source link or downloaded archive does not mean its geometry has been imported, audited, or approved for redistribution.

## Update 2026-11-02

No official STEP assembly was found for ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 or NUCLEO-F401RE. Official schematic/layout/DXF or module-level 3D files are not complete populated-board assets. Separate Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 and XIAO ESP32-C3 board models are available from their own exact source files; they are distinct products and do not substitute for those DevKit boards. Community sources for ESP32 Mini, C3 Mini and Blue Pill include incomplete footprints, distinct custom designs, and sources without a confirmed license. X-zeed/UTAC-PCB is licensed and has full CAD, but is a custom mains-voltage relay system and is excluded from the standard beginner board list. See `docs/board-model-sourcing.md` for decisions and source details.

Seeed's [content license](https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/License/) expressly licenses product documents, tutorials and associated images under CC BY-SA 4.0. It does not separately list the XIAO C3 KiCad ZIP, so the current viewer keeps attribution/share-alike notices and leaves that archive-specific scope visible for confirmation.

Further STM32F103C8T6 review found [serisman/stm32-mini-pill](https://github.com/serisman/stm32-mini-pill), a CC BY-SA 4.0 KiCad community board for LQFP-48 STM32 parts, described by its author as half the size of Blue Pill; it is not a Blue Pill geometry. [Abhi90808/STM32-Blue-Pill-Clone](https://github.com/Abhi90808/STM32-Blue-Pill-Clone) declares CERN-OHL-S v2 but is a modified board design, and its visible repository file tree does not include the 3D folder described in the README. Both remain excluded from the standard Blue Pill model slot.

## Decision

Do not treat unrelated footprints or board renders as substitute models. The Espressif C3 library footprint is not a full board; the separate Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 v1.3 PCB import is a CAD-based educational viewer, not a DevKitM-1 model, and its source archive license remains uncertain. The Blue Pill name does not identify one fixed PCB; the Nucleo source package is Altium-native and its terms do not automatically authorize public redistribution of a derived GLB. The S3 DevKit and Nucleo archives in this repository have not been converted into runtime assets. Raspberry Pi publishes use rights for Pico-family design files, and STEP-derived GLB reference viewers are integrated. This does not validate every BOM, electrical net or commercial board revision.

## Arduino model caveat

Uno R3, Nano classic and Mega 2560 R3 are based on identifiable board CAD revisions. Some package bodies are generic KiCad models attached to reference footprints. Generic shell models can explain component families but do not prove exact manufacturer identity, markings, or every clone's placement. Re-check the package-to-pad transforms and exported nodes before presenting a board as fully accurate.
